title: Declaration files
explain: A `.d.ts` file describes the types of JavaScript code without containing any logic. It lets TypeScript check a plain JavaScript library or your own old files. Most popular packages ship their own types or have them in `@types/<name>`.
exercise: Write a `.d.ts` for a small JavaScript file with two exported functions, then import it from a `.ts` file.
tip: Don't reach for `any` to silence a missing-types error. Install `@types/<package>` first, and write a small `declare module` only if none exists.
